parameters.content:
# ShiftHub — 2-Hour Reminders

Every 15 minutes, finds PENDING assignments starting 105–135 minutes from now and sends a final Telegram + email reminder. Skips anyone already reminded.

nodes.name: Pivot Settings
nodes.notes: Pivots key|value rows into a settings object.

nodes.name: Find 2-Hour Shifts
nodes.notes: Emits one item per pending staff member whose shift starts in ~2 hours.

nodes.name: Email Staff (2h)
nodes.notes: SMTP send (Gmail app password). All ShiftHub mails go from the facility mailbox.

nodes.name: Telegram Staff (2h)
nodes.notes: Best-effort Telegram notification; failure does not stop the run.

nodes.name: Mark 2h Reminder Sent
nodes.notes: Stamps the row so staff are not double-reminded.
